title: The entropy-rate dimension formula for self-similar measures on the line
summary: We prove that the Hausdorff dimension of every finite real self-similar measure equals the minimum of one and its random-walk entropy rate divided by its Lyapunov exponent. Exact overlaps are allowed, and the contraction ratios may be unequal and negative. This resolves the entropy-rate dimension conjecture.
family_title: The entropy-rate dimension formula for self-similar measures

review.reason: Proves a Hausdorff dimension formula for self-similar measures via entropy rate and Lyapunov exponent.
